name: Stall: Vague progress claim without next steps
description: Assistant claims to be working but provides no concrete next steps. Judge should evaluate this as uncertain - could stop to allow user intervention.
notes: Without explicit next steps like 'Next I will...' or 'Let me now...', the assistant is in an uncertain state. Stall detection would amplify this uncertainty if decision history showed repeated similar states.
